customManagers.description: Bump the pinned zizmor CLI version in both places it is pinned: the `version: X.Y.Z # pin the CLI` input to zizmor-action, and ZIZMOR_VERSION in the git pre-commit hook. They must move together or the local and CI gates enforce different rulesets. Copied from the isw-kudos/renovate-config :gha preset, which this repo cannot extend: the hosted Renovate app cannot read that private repo.

packageRules.description: Leave pnpm-workspace override ranges alone. They are hand-written security floors; pinning one rewrites the range to the latest major (see PR #26, which pinned the nanoid override to 6.0.1)
GitHub Actions updates use the ci: commit type, matching repo convention
Group React runtime and type packages into one PR
Group Vite, Vitest, and related plugins into one PR to keep the ecosystem in lockstep
Major updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
Automerge devDependency patch/minor updates once the required-checks gate passes
Automerge GitHub Actions digest and patch/minor updates

Zizmor: the pinned CLI version and the zizmor-action release must move together in ONE gated PR. The action ships a per-version allowlist and fails with 'Unknown version' when the CLI pin is newer than the SHA-pinned action release supports (see isw-kudos/boards#341). The workflow `version:` literal is claimed twice: the zizmor customManager reads it as the github-releases dep zizmorcore/zizmor (which also bumps the hook), and the built-in github-actions manager reads it as the docker dep ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor. ghcr has no release timestamps, so under the default timestamp-required minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour the ghcr dep stays pending and is dropped from the branch; it is listed only so it cannot get its own automerging branch. separateMajorMinor: false keeps a CLI major (e.g. 2.0) in the same PR as the still-0.x action instead of splitting it onto a major-zizmor branch. Mirrors the isw-kudos/renovate-config default preset. This rule MUST stay after the GitHub Actions automerge rule so automerge: false wins.
